questions.instruction: Urgency 1-5: 1=cosmetic/hygiene, 2=nice-to-have, 3=worth doing soon, 4=should schedule this week, 5=drop everything / live incident risk

questions.name: worth_surfacing
questions.instruction:
Is this finding FRESH and still unaddressed — describing work that has NOT already been done, superseded, or covered through another channel (Jira ticket, other agent, later fix)? Answer FALSE if the finding is stale, a duplicate/earlier copy of an already-handled issue, or its own text says the work is done or planned elsewhere (e.g. 'plan ready', 'root cause found', 'superseded', 'awaiting X'). Answer TRUE only if acting on it now would not duplicate existing work.
Example FALSE (stale): 'AE-change to Freshdesk plan ready; awaiting build authorization + AE field confirmation' — the plan exists; channel is Jira.
Example TRUE (fresh): 'Replay gym leaves open canon entries for deleted recipes and transient canary failures surface as defects' — no other channel covers it; action still pending.
